_comment: Expected findings per fixture, measured with all five extractors available. 'must': ids that have to appear. 'allowed': ids that may appear, each with a reason. Every other id in FINDING_CATALOGUE must NOT appear: a false positive fails like a false negative. 'forbid_severity': severities that must not occur at all.

01_clean_de.note: Single column, German with umlauts, tabular dates beside titles (label/value layout, must not count as two columns).

02_two_column.note: Sidebar layout, content stream alternates left/right per row. Mixing is measured in the extractors' output, not inferred from the columns.

02b_two_column_streamwise.note: Same layout, content stream column by column. pypdf and PyMuPDF follow the stream and keep the columns apart; they must not be named as mixing.

03_header_contact.note: Two pages, contact only in a header row repeated on both pages.

03b_header_artifact.note: One page, contact only inside marked content /Artifact /Subtype /Header.

04_icon_font.note: Contact line with icon glyphs mapped to the Private Use Area.

05_table.note: Experience as a ruled table. Table cells must not be reported as columns.

allowed.images_present: the page is one image; the image finding is a true statement about the file

06_image_only.note: Whole page is a raster image, no text layer.

07_outlines.note: All glyphs drawn as filled paths. Straight glyph edges must not be mistaken for table rules.

08_letter_spaced.note: Headings set with 6 pt character spacing. Extractors split them into single letters, so headings are not recognised (sections_missing, profile_missing), and extractors that do and do not split disagree.

09_oversize.note: Clean CV plus an incompressible photo; file above 2.5 MB.

11_ligatures_mapped.note: Ligature glyphs fi/fl whose ToUnicode CMap maps them to 'fi'/'fl'. Ligatures in the typesetting alone are no finding.

11b_ligatures_unmapped.note: Control case: ToUnicode maps the glyphs to U+FB01/U+FB02, so the extracted text contains ligature characters.

12_bullets_no_evidence.note: Task-only bullets and a profile of soft-skill adjectives.

13_contact_links_only.note: Visible words 'E-Mail', 'Telefon', 'LinkedIn'; addresses only in link annotations.

14_skill_bars.note: Four skill levels shown only as filled bars.
